report.summary: Converted 5 surviving findings into 6 actionable items. One item requires finding a missing function definition before proceeding.
risks: Missing guard function may cause runtime error in production if not defined elsewhere
Floor check bypass could allow secrets to leak via direct ollama.run() calls
Docstring contradictions may mislead developers about side effects
todos: Add floor_check call to ollama.py's run method
Fix docstrings in drafts.py to accurately describe filesystem writes
Audit codebase for direct calls to ollama.run() that bypass session.py
Investigate render_arms for bare variable access to by_provenance

items.title: Locate _refuse_primary_checkout definition or add it
items.why_now: Critical: if undefined, _git_in_worktree will raise NameError, breaking the primary checkout guard, which is a core safety mechanism.

steps.do: Search entire codebase for definition of _refuse_primary_checkout
steps.verified_by: grep -rn 'def _refuse_primary_checkout' daedalus/ returns a location, or no results.

items.assumption: If the function is defined elsewhere, no changes needed. If not, add definition.

items.title: Add floor_check call to ollama.py's run method
items.why_now: Confirmed: ollama.run() bypasses secret floor check, allowing potential secret leakage when called directly outside session.py.

steps.do: Add floor_check call at the beginning of the run method in daedalus/providers/ollama.py
steps.verified_by: grep -n 'floor_check' daedalus/providers/ollama.py shows the call; run unit tests to confirm no regression.

items.assumption: floor_check is importable and compatible with ollama.py's signature.

items.title: Audit codebase for direct calls to ollama.run() bypassing session.py
items.why_now: Floor check bypass is only a problem if direct calls exist. Need to confirm which code paths invoke ollama.run() outside session.py.

steps.do: Search for direct calls to ollama.run() or imports of run from ollama outside session.py and tests

items.assumption: If no direct calls exist, the risk is mitigated; if calls exist, they must be routed through session.py or floor_check added.

items.title: Fix docstrings in drafts.py to accurately reflect filesystem writes
items.why_now: Confirmed false docstrings: set_status writes to filesystem via p.write_text(), contradicting the module docstring. This misleads developers about side effects.

steps.do: Update module docstring to state that set_status writes to runs/drafts/ directory
steps.verified_by: grep -n 'write_text' daedalus/kairos/drafts.py confirms write; docstring updated.

steps.do: Update apply_payload docstring to mention it indirectly writes via set_status
steps.verified_by: Check docstring of apply_payload for accuracy.

items.assumption: No further side effects beyond those already implemented.

items.title: Fix bare variable access to by_provenance in render_arms
items.why_now: Critical: if render_arms contains 'for prov in sorted(by_provenance):' without defining by_provenance, it will raise NameError at runtime.

steps.do: Examine full render_arms function in daedalus/eval/report.py for bare 'by_provenance' usage
steps.verified_by: grep -n 'by_provenance' daedalus/eval/report.py shows all usages; confirm no bare variable access.

items.assumption: If bare variable exists, replace with result['by_provenance']. If not, no change needed.

items.title: Verify compare_to_history checks shape.truncated flag
items.why_now: Narrowed finding: compare_to_history may not inspect shape.truncated, potentially missing missing fields. Need to locate and verify.

steps.do: Find definition of compare_to_history in codebase
Check if the function inspects shape.truncated or notes field
steps.verified_by: Examine source for checks on .truncated or notes.

items.assumption: If function does not check truncated, add the check. If not found, document as unknown.
